preconditions.description: Both input strings s and t have lengths between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s) and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is the count of valid ways to choose k >= 1 non-overlapping substrings from s, where each substring contains t, modulo 10^9 + 7.
The output value corresponds to the number of valid sequences of non-overlapping intervals [a_i, b_i] such that each interval contains t as a substring.
